title: Open the March Catalog Contiguously
teaser: The new month must start on the day after the previous shard.
full_text: Verify in both locale date sequences that 2036-02-29 is followed directly by 2036-03-01 with no missing canonical day.

title: Resolve Local Time Explicitly Across DST Start
teaser: A spring-forward wall time must not create an ambiguous instant.
full_text: Resolve fixtures around the DST start transition with the timezone database and verify the nonexistent or shifted-time policy is deterministic.

title: Keep Both Instants During a DST Fold
teaser: A repeated wall clock time must not be silently collapsed into one instant.
full_text: Run the same fall-back wall time with both offsets and verify the two canonical instants remain distinct.

title: Round Trip the Julian Day Conversion
teaser: Date conversion must not shift the civil day on a round trip.
full_text: Convert boundary and mid-range fixtures to Julian Day and back and verify civil date and time components are preserved within the defined tolerance.

title: Include House System in Calculation Identity
teaser: Different house systems must not share the same cached result identity.
full_text: Calculate one birth input with Placidus and Whole Sign and verify cache identity and result metadata preserve the selected house system.

title: Derive Retrograde State from Velocity Sign
teaser: Planetary direction must not be inferred from display labels.
full_text: Run positive negative and near-zero longitude-speed fixtures and verify retrograde classification follows the canonical velocity-sign policy.

title: Preserve Circular Separation at the 360 Boundary
teaser: The difference between 359 and 1 degrees must not be interpreted as 358 degrees.
full_text: Send longitudes on both sides of zero to the aspect engine and verify minimum circular separation is calculated correctly.

title: Apply Orb Policy Per Aspect Type
teaser: A single fixed orb for every aspect would weaken the contract.
full_text: Run boundary fixtures for conjunction square trine opposition and sextile and verify each major aspect uses its own configured orb threshold.

title: Normalize Unicode Before Numerology
teaser: Visually identical names must not diverge because of code-point composition.
full_text: Calculate equivalent names using composed and decomposed accents and verify normalization produces the same canonical character sequence.

title: Make Name Letter Rules Locale Aware
teaser: Turkish I variants cannot rely on generic English lowercasing.
full_text: Run TR and EN fixtures containing I İ ı and i and verify locale-aware normalization follows the documented mapping policy.

title: Resolve BaZi Solar-Term Boundaries from Ephemeris
teaser: The month pillar must not change on a hard-coded calendar date.
full_text: Calculate fixtures immediately before and after a solar-term instant and verify the month pillar changes at the canonical solar-longitude boundary.

title: Preserve Timezone Semantics for the BaZi Hour Pillar
teaser: Converting birth time to UTC must not erase the local double-hour rule.
full_text: Calculate the same wall time in different timezone fixtures and verify the hour pillar follows the defined local-time policy.

title: Delete Profile Dependencies Transactionally
teaser: Partial deletion must not leave orphaned records.
full_text: Delete a profile fixture linked to notes journal entries and calculation history and verify the cascade policy leaves every target table consistent in one transaction.

title: Separate Restore Dry Run from Real Import
teaser: A restore preview must not mutate the database.
full_text: Send the same backup package through dry-run and real import flows and verify persistent revisions change only during the second phase.

title: Validate Backup Encryption Metadata Integrity
teaser: A package with modified KDF or cipher parameters must not be accepted.
full_text: Tamper with one encryption-metadata field and verify validation fails on integrity before attempting decryption.

title: Block Spreadsheet Formula Injection in CSV
teaser: Special leading characters in user text must not become spreadsheet commands.
full_text: Export values starting with equals plus minus and at signs and verify safe escaping prevents formula execution.

title: Test PDF Font Fallback with Turkish Glyphs
teaser: Missing glyphs must not render as empty boxes in reports.
full_text: Generate a Turkish report containing Ç ğ İ ı Ö ş and Ü and verify the embedded or fallback font chain renders every glyph.

title: Keep PDF Headings with Their First Content Block
teaser: A section heading must not be stranded at the bottom of a page.
full_text: Generate a multi-page report from a long interpretation fixture and verify pagination keeps a heading with at least its first content block.

title: Use One Entitlement Resolver for Free and PRO PDF
teaser: Preview and export must not make different access decisions.
full_text: Run Free temporary-unlock and lifetime-PRO fixtures through preview and final export and verify both use the same entitlement result.

title: Protect Temporary PRO Duration with Monotonic Time
teaser: Moving device time backward must not extend an unlock.
full_text: During an active temporary entitlement move wall-clock time backward and verify expiry is decided from the rollback-resistant time source.

title: Bound Trusted Entitlement State During Offline Start
teaser: No network connection must not imply unlimited PRO access.
full_text: Cold-start offline with a previously verified temporary entitlement and verify grace and expiry rules use the stored trusted timestamp.

title: Scan TR and EN UI Key Parity
teaser: A required UI key present in one language must not disappear from the other.
full_text: Compare release locale key sets and verify exact parity except for explicitly documented locale-only exceptions.

title: Test Layout with Long English Copy
teaser: Translation width must not break buttons or cards.
full_text: Render the longest English-label fixtures at a narrow phone width and verify there is no overflow clipped critical text or unreachable action.

title: Keep Actions Reachable at Two Times Text Scale
teaser: Large text must not remove access to essential controls.
full_text: Render primary calculation and report screens at text scale 2.0 and verify every essential action remains reachable by scrolling.

title: Avoid Duplicate Screen Reader Announcements
teaser: Semantics should not repeat the same visible information as noise.
full_text: Inspect icon-based primary actions in the semantics tree and verify label hint and value do not redundantly announce the visible text.

title: Measure Cold-Start IO Budget
teaser: Eagerly loading every catalog at startup can damage performance.
full_text: Profile release cold start for asset and database IO and verify the critical first-screen path remains inside the defined performance budget.

title: Bound Peak Memory During Large Backup Import
teaser: Restore should not duplicate the entire package in memory unnecessarily.
full_text: Import a high-record-count fixture and verify peak memory and streaming chunk behavior stay within the defined budget.

title: Rollback an Interrupted Migration Atomically
teaser: A crash mid-migration must not leave a corrupted schema.
full_text: Force an error inside a migration transaction and verify the next launch sees either the old consistent schema or the completed new schema and no intermediate state.

title: Recompute Asset Hashes for the Release Manifest
teaser: Old checksum evidence is invalid after source changes.
full_text: Recompute hashes from canonical content and static-data files and verify exact equality with the release manifest values.

title: Scan March for Date and Locale Parity
teaser: Both languages must cover the same 31 canonical days.
full_text: Parse the March TR and EN shards and verify 2036-03-01 through 2036-03-31 have no missing duplicate out-of-order or wrong-locale rows.

title: Close the March Shard with Duplicate Auditing
teaser: Originality evidence is required before advancing the month.
full_text: Scan March titles teasers and full text against the historical catalog for exact duplicates and fix any match before advancing the ledger.
